//: aocd configuration. Copy to aoc.config.json where you start aocd, or point --config <file> / AOC_CONFIG at it. Every key is optional and the values below are the built-in defaults. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory (~ is your home). Keys starting with // are comments; a //key shows an optional setting without enabling it. Env overrides: AOC_PORT, AOC_HOST, AOC_DATA_DIR, AOC_PUBLIC_URL. Secrets never go here: see .env.example.
//mode: development | production. Production refuses to start unless managed sessions are isolated (supervisor.sessionUser + readOnlySessionUser, aocd as root) and the KEK comes from keys.masterKeyFile (outside dataDir, 0400/0600, owned by aocd's user; never AOC_MASTER_KEY, never generated), every promotion credential profile (see promotion) is defined in supervisor.credentialProfilesFile, and with intake.requireScan refuses attachments (503) unless an anti-virus engine scans them. See docs/runbooks/credential-isolation.md §4.
//publicUrl: https://aoc.example.com — the origin browsers use (links, WebAuthn). Defaults to http://localhost:<port>; set it when aocd sits behind a proxy or TLS.

keys.//: Key-encryption key for the per-scope body keys (crypto-shred, §13). Development order: AOC_MASTER_KEY env (warned about at every start), then masterKeyFile, else <dataDir>/master.key is generated (0600) - only while the data dir holds no data; beside existing data aocd refuses to start instead. Production mode accepts only an existing masterKeyFile outside the data dir, per docs/runbooks/key-custody.md (R6).

supervisor.//: Managed claude sessions. sidecar/hook/mcp commands are filled in by aocd: dist/bin/aoc-*.mjs next to the aocd bundle, else the package sources via tsx. Only envAllowlist variables reach a session; deploy credentials live solely in the credential profiles file (§3).
supervisor.//credentialProfilesFile: /etc/aoc/credential-profiles.json — { "profiles": { "<name>": { "env": { "GIT_SSH_COMMAND": "ssh -i {{file:ssh-key}}" }, "files": { "ssh-key": "/etc/aoc/keys/<name>" }, "push": { "refs": ["refs/heads/feature/**", "refs/heads/uat/{ticketId}"] }, "session": { "env": { "NPM_READ_TOKEN": "..." } } } } }, readable only by the user aocd runs as; never on developer machines. env/files are the credential: only aocd holds them, and it pushes with them for a session through the push gateway (a session runs `git push aoc <commit>:refs/heads/<branch>`; push.refs says which branches, never main, release/*, tags or deletions). A session is given only the profile's `session` part (model-visible: never a key that can push); its files come as private per-turn copies. See docs/runbooks/credential-isolation.md.
supervisor.//isolation: user | none. Unset: user once sessionUser is set or in production, else none (sessions run as aocd's own user and can read its keys and databases: development only, warned on every launch).
supervisor.//sessionUser: aoc-agent — unprivileged OS user every credentialed turn runs as (claude, hooks, MCP server, tools). aocd must run as root to switch to it.
supervisor.//readOnlySessionUser: aoc-reader — OS user for read-only (triage) types, with its own uid and group; required in production.
supervisor.//runner: Optional argv prefix that starts each turn in its isolated context instead of a direct uid/gid switch (a per-session container wrapper, or ["setpriv","--reuid={uid}","--regid={gid}","--clear-groups","--"]). Placeholders: {user} {uid} {gid} {sessionId} {sessionDir} {cwd}.

decisions.//soleApproverFallback: Off by CEO decision: with one Approver, their own requests wait for a second Approver (never credit top-ups).
decisions.//webhookUrl: https://hooks.example.com/aoc — opt-in notification for new and aging decisions (R15).

compliance.//: ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping (provisional until the compliance lead stamps it). Like registryFile and metering.rateCardFile, the default falls back to the copy packaged with aocd (dist/config next to dist/bin, or the checkout's config/) when it is not next to this file; the startup banner names the file in use, or says the built-in default is.

fx.//: Daily USD→MYR = BNM Kuala Lumpur interbank middle rate for `session`, RM per 1 USD, for the local date (docs/research/bnm-fx.md). Session 1700: the page (its default view) is extracted with Haiku, escalating once to Sonnet, else carried forward (flagged), then cross-checked with the BNM Open API at <apiUrl>/date/<date>?session=<session>. BNM publishes a session about 40 minutes after its time; each retry time is another attempt while the day's rate is unpublished or the page unreadable, and the last attempt decides (holiday or flagged carry-forward). Rate changes apply forward only. extractor: claude-cli | anthropic-sdk (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) | fake.
fx.//session: 0900 | 1200 | 1700. For the noon rate set session 1200, runAtLocalTime 13:00 and retryAtLocalTimes ["13:30", "15:00"]: the page cannot show 1200 without a form POST, so the rate is the API figure alone (extractor api, no page cross-check).
fx.//recheckPreviousWeekday: The first run of a day re-checks the previous weekday if it was stamped a holiday or its page was unreadable: if BNM has since published it, that day is attempted again. Metering closes each day at 00:15 and a closed day is never restated, so a late figure for a closed day is only reported (fx.alert).
fx.//sanity: Outside min–max or more than maxDailyChangePct from the previous rate: rejected. Above softFlagPct: accepted only if the API agrees exactly at 4 dp.
fx.//reconcileTolerance: Largest page-vs-API difference after rounding both to 4 dp; larger is a mismatch (re-fetch once, then a discrepancy decision).
fx.//carryForwardAlertWeekdays: Weekdays in a row without a live rate (holidays count, weekends do not) before a manual check is requested; BNM's longest holiday run in 2025–26 was 2 weekdays.

audit.//: Nightly off-host anchor of the chain head (§13, R2). git: one signed commit per anchor in a separate repo, ideally pushed off-host via anchorRemote; rfc3161: a timestamp from tsaUrl. See docs/runbooks/anchoring.md.
audit.//gpgKeyId: 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01234567 — OpenPGP key that signs anchor commits; Verify then requires a valid signature from it.
audit.//gnupgHome: /var/lib/aoc/gnupg — keyring used to sign and verify anchor commits (default: aocd's GNUPGHOME).
audit.//tsaCaFile: /etc/aoc/tsa-ca.pem — CA bundle that verifies RFC 3161 token signatures (without it only the imprint and the time are checked).
audit.//tsaUntrustedFile: /etc/aoc/tsa-intermediates.pem — intermediate certificates for the TSA chain.
audit.//backup: Encrypted daily backup (G-21, R6) of aoc.db, bodies.db, blobs/, RFC 3161 tokens and evidence packs — never the KEK. Runs only once backupKeyFile is set; restore with `aocd restore`. See docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md.
audit.//backupKeyFile: /etc/aoc/backup.key — 32 bytes (64 hex chars), mode 0400; a different key from the KEK, kept apart from the KEK, the data dir and the backups.
audit.//backupCopyCommand: ["rclone", "copy", "{file}", "offsite:aoc-backups"] — runs without a shell after each backup; {file} is the backup's path.

intake.//: End-user portal uploads (§7, R4). aocd accepts intake request bodies up to maxVideoBytes + 1 MiB; every other request body is capped at 1 MiB.
intake.//scanner: auto = ClamAV (clamdscan, else clamscan, on PATH) when installed, else the builtin heuristic (EICAR, script polyglots, active PDF content), which is not anti-virus. clamav | builtin | none pin one. GET /api/health and aoc doctor report the active scanner.

promotion.//: Where promotions, rollbacks and break-glass push, and with which credential profile (docs/runbooks/credential-isolation.md §4 item 9). A project without an entry pushes to the origin of its service clone (<dataDir>/git/<projectId>.git) with promoteCredentialProfile. Only aocd holds these profiles: no process type may name one (launches are refused), and production mode refuses to start unless supervisor.credentialProfilesFile defines every one named here. Governed configuration: a change is chained as config.changed.
promotion.//projects: { "prj_web": { "promotionRemote": "git@github.com:your-org/web.git", "promoteCredentialProfile": "web-promote" } } — keyed by project id. promotionRemote is ssh, https or an absolute local path, never with a credential in it (the profile holds that), and wins over the clone's origin; it is never read from the project's own repository. A misspelt key is an error; an id no project has is only warned about at start.

selfModification.//: Repos that are AOC itself; changes under protectedPaths (the Tier 1 core in docs/compliance/self-modification-boundary.md: governance, audit, credit, ingest, supervisor, build and rule files) are refused to agents and logged outside AOC (§13). Set aocRepoPaths to every clone of the AOC repo that managed sessions can reach; the guard protects no core code while it is empty.

identity.//: WebAuthn relying party. origin and rpId default to publicUrl's origin and hostname.
identity.//bootstrapTokenFile: .aoc/bootstrap.token — one-time token for the first Approver (printed once by `aoc init`); AOC_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN works too.
